import html # Template for displaying a user profile. The placeholders will be filled with the # sanitized user data. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{bio}

{status_msg}
""" def show_user_profile(name: str, bio: str, status_msg: str) -> str: """ Render a user profile safely for inclusion in an HTML page. Parameters ---------- name : str The user's display name. bio : str A potentially multi‑sentence biography. May contain HTML special characters. status_msg : str A short one‑liner or status message. May contain HTML special characters. Returns ------- str The fully formatted, escaped profile markup ready for rendering in a browser. Notes ----- All user input is escaped using :func:`html.escape` to neutralise characters that could otherwise break the HTML structure or be interpreted as markup, mitigating CWE‑74 (improper neutralisation of special elements in output used by a downstream component). """ # Escape user input to avoid injection of HTML or script tags. safe_name = html.escape(name, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status_msg = html.escape(status_msg, quote=True) # Format the profile using the sanitized values. return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status_msg=safe_status_msg )
